correctness.rationale: Strict convexity of the Euler–Lotka kernel gives monotonicity under convex order, and strict decrease of the Euler–Lotka transform in the growth factor converts expectation order to root order. Piecewise-linear interpolation proves the adjacent-age lower convex-order extremizer; the endpoint chord proves the upper extremizer. The neutral case and equality conditions are separated. Exact rational replay checks 76,416 finite expectation inequalities and the worked polynomial brackets.

value.rationale: Integer age classes are standard in Leslie demography and discretized generation-time data. When the mean reproductive age is noninteger, the continuous Jensen extremizer is infeasible; the theorem gives the exact attainable replacement, a sharp upper companion under an age window, and an interpretable monotonicity principle for timing dispersion. This turns coarse life-history summaries into rigorous growth bounds without assuming a parametric reproductive-age distribution.
